construction.signal_definition_exact: amendlag(e,t) = MEDIAN of d(p) in calendar days over the entity's resolvable measurement pairs p whose AMENDMENT acceptance session falls in the trailing 63 trading sessions ending at decision close t (TRAIL_SESSIONS=63, window inclusive of t). d(p) = calendar days between the two acceptance DATES (UTC), amendment date minus original date, untrimmed (no cap, no winsorization — 3 negative lags min -1 and 107 zero lags kept, disclosed anomalies). Defined iff >= 1 in-window pair (else entity is OUT — ineligible, NOT zero-ranked). Even counts average the two middle order statistics. Timestamps only: no price, volume, value, direction, or count input in the anchor.
construction.event_definition: pair p = (original Form-4, amendment 4/A) linked by match key (issuerCik, rptOwnerCik, periodOfReport) against the pinned originals index (342,801 keys over 345,150 pinned type-4 XML files; census machinery VERBATIM). Amendment universe = 3,059 parseable 4/A XML docs re-ingested this cycle (3,062 accessions fetched, 3 non-XML). Census resolvable = 1,877; measurement pairs after fail-closed stages = 1,635 (stages: original_not_stream_acceptance 239, amendment_stamp_missing 0, amendment_stamp_crosscheck_mismatch 0, issuer_not_cohort_member 3). Acceptance-row rule BOTH stamps: originals restricted to stream_acceptance accessions (period_fallback rows fail-closed excluded; stream acceptance per accession = MIN row stamp, 271 of 285,082 accessions carry >1 distinct stamp); amendments = pinned submissions acceptanceDateTime cross-checked vs re-ingest index.json primary-doc last-modified, ET-naive date within [UTC date - 1, UTC date]; a pair failing either side is excluded fail-closed. Issuer = doc issuerCik, cohort members only. Tie rule FROZEN ex ante: original with the EARLIEST stream acceptance, tie broken by lexicographically smallest accession (2,070 keys with multiple originals, 30 pairs tie-broken).
construction.direction: SHORT the top tercile of amendlag (late corrections = long-lived misstatements, disclosure-evasion signal) and LONG the bottom tercile (prompt corrections = routine repairs), equal-weight within legs, per-sector net zero; CASH absorbs residual; >= 1 non-CASH leg per active decision else the book abstains that date (counted); gross <= 2.0; all books reconcile to 1.0 within 1e-9.
construction.entry_exit_clock: Decision bar = DAILY close grid on EODHD prices (SPY session calendar). gate(t) = the decision session's close; only acceptances <= gate(t) enter any exposure; PIT convention: an acceptance enters exposure at the first decision session on/after its UTC calendar date. Fill bar = STRICT_NEXT_BAR declared ex ante (NO same-day-inclusive variant): qualifying amendment acceptance session s -> entry fill at the first allowed session close strictly after s; a fill references only names with a bar at that session; missing bar = the order does not exist (no silent substitute pricing).
construction.holding_period: H = 21 trading days from the LAST qualifying pair-acceptance session; each new qualifying pair re-arms the exit (repeated late corrections extend the state); exits at the H-th close after the latest re-arm; fold boundaries force flat; substrate-end windows exit-at-last-close.
construction.book_form_sector_rule: within each frozen sector tag with >= 6 eligible ranked names (SECTOR_BOOKABLE_NAMES=6) the tercile book trades; else that sector abstains for t (abstentions counted). [SPEC from D1 proposal — the book was never run: D2 measured rho/counts/cost-rate arithmetic only.]
construction.universe: cohort_v9 death-inclusive, exactly as P3-frozen in V13: 410 ALIVE_EVIDENCED + 1,769 DEAD_EVIDENCED = 2,179 filer-entities (sha256 6a95401ff84bff2144ac3c0b9426a6fa86daf3dde8d478195666249e3fa2aa62). Pair enters only if its ISSUER is a cohort member. Per-decision eligibility: >= 63 price bars through t (BARS_FLOOR=63) AND ADV63 >= 2,000,000 USD (mean daily raw close*volume over last <=63 bars) AND raw close >= 1.00 USD AND exposure defined (>= 1 in-window pair) AND frozen sector tag has >= 6 eligible ranked names. Measured panel: 292 entities, 50,114 (entity, date) points, 2,158 dates defined of 2,180 grid sessions. Measured disclosure: the 4/A re-ingest enumerated submissions_alive metadata (410 ALIVE CIKs), so measurement pairs carry 1,635 ALIVE / 0 DEAD — an enumeration-surface property of the pinned substrate, not a survivorship filter applied at D2.

construction.missing_data_law: (1) Missing bar = the order does not exist, no silent substitute pricing (STRICT_NEXT_BAR). (2) Period-fallback originals excluded fail-closed and counted (239 pairs died there). (3) Date-only stamp on EITHER side -> pair excluded fail-closed to the defect table; asserted lags never authorized. (4) dV-unmeasurable pairs (close missing at a stamp date) carry dV=None, counted, never guessed (9 pairs; P2-relevant). (5) Negative lags kept untrimmed. (6) Spearman returns None below n=10 (SPEARMAN_MIN_N) or on zero variance -> UNMEASURED -> fail-closed, never a pass by absence. (7) L-I3: UNTRADABLE band resolution raises BandResolutionError fail-closed — the silent 10 bps fallback is forbidden (scoring-time). (8) Census/pair reconciliation fail-closed via PairDefectError (any drift dies the run).
construction.tie_breaking_law: (1) Multiple originals per match key: earliest stream acceptance, then lexicographically smallest accession (frozen before any rho existed). (2) Stream acceptance per accession: MIN row stamp. (3) Median with even count: average of the two middle order statistics. (4) Tercile ties at a boundary join the LOWER (long-side) tercile — deterministic and conservative (proposal book_form). (5) Sham permutation: cells iterated in sorted (session, sector) order, values (origin entity, accession)-sorted, numpy PCG64 default_rng seed 20260912 (SHAM_SEED). (6) Panel iteration sorted by key for deterministic float accumulation.
